headline: Coca-Cola stock performing well with all-time highs; product quality/regulatory issues in India; company planning facility demolition and restructuring

signals.summary: Coca-Cola stock reached all-time highs surpassing $90/share, significantly outperforming PepsiCo competitors. Strong stock performance indicates healthy financial position and investor confidence.
signals.suggestedAction: Positive rapport opportunity: Use as talking point about account's market strength and financial stability. May indicate capacity for budget expansion and investment in new initiatives.

signals.summary: India regulatory authorities found relabeled Coca-Cola, PepsiCo, and Nestle products at third-party facilities. Indicates potential supply chain control, counterfeiting, or compliance issues requiring investigation and remediation.
signals.suggestedAction: Monitor account's response and remediation efforts. Potential risk to brand reputation and operational continuity in India market. May create internal demand for compliance/quality monitoring solutions.

signals.summary: Coca-Cola planning demolition of vacant building at Grand Rapids site and considering 5 other projects in the area. Indicates local facility optimization and capital allocation activities.
signals.suggestedAction: Neutral signal on account relationship. Document as operational/facility management activity. No direct bearing on product/service renewal unless it signals broader restructuring.
